integrations.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again or ask your administrator.
integrations.freshAuthentication: Please sign in again to confirm this security-sensitive change.
integrations.forbidden: You do not have permission to make this change.
integrations.disconnectBody: This connection is blocked in the CRM immediately. Revoking the Slack token may need another attempt. Disconnecting does not delete existing CRM records or already sent messages.
integrations.callbackConnected: Slack is connected. Choose a channel to finish setup.
integrations.callbackFailed: Slack could not be connected. Check the app configuration and try again.
integrations.mcpDisabled: AI connections have not been enabled on this server. Ask your administrator to enable the MCP server and configure a public HTTPS address.
integrations.publicEndpoint: Cloud AI clients need a reachable server address. A localhost address is for local clients only.
integrations.marketBody: An app marketplace is planned. Installing apps here is not available yet.
integrations.revocationPending: Disconnected locally. Slack could not confirm revocation. Retry disconnecting to finish removing its access.
integrations.slackSetupStep1: Create a Slack app for your workspace and add this redirect URL under OAuth & Permissions.
integrations.slackSetupStep2: Add the bot scopes chat:write and channels:read. Invite the app to the public channels you want to use.
integrations.slackSetupStep3: Set SLACK_CLIENT_ID and SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET in your server configuration, then restart Warpdrive.
integrations.slackSetupStep4: Keep Slack token rotation disabled for this first connector release.
integrations.emptySearch: No integrations match your search. Try another name or category.
integrations.emptyConnections: Your tools, connected in one place
integrations.emptyConnectionsBody: Connect an account from the directory to get started. You can review and revoke AI access here too.
integrations.savedConnections: {count, plural, =0 {No saved connections yet.} one {# saved connection.} other {# saved connections.}}
integrations.comingSoon: This integration is on the roadmap. Connecting accounts is not available yet.
integrations.currentGrant: This connection exposes all MCP tools your CRM role permits. A separate read-only connection is not yet available.
integrations.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the URL and copy it manually.
integrations.promptCopied: Prompt copied. Paste it into your connected assistant.

_composer.sendUnconfirmed: We could not confirm the send. Check the thread before trying again.

workspace.loadError: Could not load the mailbox. Your current messages remain available.
workspace.threadError: This conversation could not be loaded or is no longer available.
workspace.saveFailed: Draft could not be saved. Keep this reply open and try again.

flow.freshRequired: Confirm your identity again before changing security settings.

workflows.publishedHint: Runs use the published version. Save and publish your changes to include them.
workflows.runError: This run stopped before completion. Review its configuration and permissions.

confirmations.pauseBody: Pausing blocks new operations through this connection in the CRM. Operations already started may still complete.
confirmations.revokeClientBody: Access to the CRM for {client} will be revoked. Operations already started may still complete.
confirmations.removeAppBody: Removing this app blocks its local access. Requests already started and revocation with the provider may need follow-up. {retentionSummary}

operator.credentialsPrivate: Store credentials only in protected server-side storage. Keep them out of URLs, screenshots and logs.
operator.readiness: Check the service configuration. Stored credentials do not establish account authorization or a working connection.
operator.localChecks: Use the {profile} profile and synthetic data for local checks. These checks do not require a real provider account.
operator.capabilityLimit: This version does not support {action}. Choose a supported action.

errors.accountMismatch: The selected account does not match {account}. The existing connection is unchanged.
errors.resourceUnavailable: A selected resource is no longer available. Review your resource selection and permissions before continuing.
errors.accessCheckFailed: The access check did not pass. Review the displayed error details.
errors.reauthorizationRequired: This account needs renewed authorization. Reconnect the same account.
errors.securityHold: This connection is on a security hold. Contact an administrator for review.
errors.unknownOutcome: The send outcome is unknown. The request may have been accepted. Review its status before sending again.
errors.rateLimited: {provider} is currently limiting further requests. Review the status again after {retryAt}.
errors.loadFailed: The information could not be loaded. Try fetching it again.
errors.unsupportedRecurrence: This connection does not support converting this Iranian-calendar recurrence for {provider}. Keep the original rule.

notifications.configurationRequired: Initial configuration for this connection is incomplete.
notifications.configured: Server configuration is complete. Account authorization and connection health are checked separately.
notifications.authorized: Authorization for {provider} was saved for {account}. Review resource selection and connection health separately.
notifications.healthUnknown: Connection health is not known yet. Check access and resources.
notifications.healthStale: The last successful check at {checkedAt} is no longer recent. Check the connection again.
notifications.localTested: The local check passed. This result does not validate a connection to a real {provider} account.
notifications.providerValidated: For {provider}, {scopeSummary} was tested with {account} at {checkedAt}. This result covers only that scope.
notifications.draftSaved: Draft saved; no message was sent.
notifications.queued: Request queued; sending has not started.
notifications.accepted: {provider} accepted the request; delivery is not confirmed yet.
notifications.partialOutcome: {done, number} of {total, number} items completed. Review the remaining outcomes.
notifications.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. Operations already started may still complete.
notifications.custodianHold: The shared connection is paused until an authorized custodian is confirmed.
notifications.removed: This connection was removed and can no longer be used.

empty.resources: No selectable resources are available for this account. Review the permissions and selected account.
empty.deliveryHistory: No history is shown for this connection in the selected period.
empty.workflowRuns: No runs are recorded for this workflow version in the selected period.

regional.independent: Language, calendar, digit display and time zone are separate settings. Changing the display does not change the stored date.
regional.numberingLimit: This version offers digit selection in the Farsi interface. German and English display Latin digits.
regional.allDay: This is an all-day event with no clock time. Its end date is included.
regional.ambiguousTime: This time occurs twice. A new or changed time uses the earlier occurrence.
regional.invalidWallTime: This time does not exist in the selected time zone. Choose another time.
